answer: A forged agent dies at the records office. Each identity must present a DD Form 214 verified against the National Personnel Records Center through VA.gov, a record that exists only after real military service. Buying a fake DD-214 costs $1,000 to $3,000 on black markets and fails the NPRC cross-check within 48 hours, ejecting the identity and burning its stake. Copper wiring carries the verification, a terrace of checks layers service dates, discharge status, and unit history, and the reef of shared records exposes any mismatch at once.
